purpose: Four fresh questions testing evidence completeness and evidence-only answering with the strengthened skill; not a language-profile A/B test or independent holdout
planner_answerer: openai/gpt-6-astra, current interactive session, same author and reviewer; no independent judge or pinned inference replay
source_handling: Original RST bytes stored under .md names to use the existing probe. No text conversion, pruning or oracle expansion. This ingestion limitation is part of the measured fixture.
retrieval: PR HEAD baseline_probe.run, lexical, one frozen lookup per question, 800 DTO tokens, at most 3 sources and 2 sections/source, PYTHONHASHSEED=0; no retries or query edits after results

rubric.sufficient: Every listed obligation is supported semantically by visible evidence. Explicit logical implications count; verbatim phrasing is not required. Paths or titles alone cannot supply a missing relation. Do not demand details absent from the question.
rubric.partial: At least one but not all obligations supported. Answer the supported part and state the missing part.
rubric.insufficient: No requested behavior supported. Abstain without asserting the opposite.
rubric.separate_denominators: Evidence sufficiency, grounded answer correctness, citations and abstention reported separately. Handler errors are blockers, not retrieval misses. No hypothetical answer scores.
rubric.scope: Skill-guided smoke test only; no claim of improvement without skill-off control. All prompts, source hashes, raw traces, packets and actual authored answers retained.
